annotations.proposed_function: Expanded polyQ stretch binds to TAFII130, interfering with CREB-dependent transcription
annotations.evidence: TAFII130 strongly bound to the truncated DRPLA protein with an expanded polyQ stretch (Q82; Fig. 1a).

annotations.proposed_function: Interacts with TAFII130 and co‑localizes with cytoplasmic aggregate bodies via its expanded polyQ stretch
annotations.evidence: The interaction between TAFII130 and expanded polyQ stretches was clearly demonstrated (Fig. 1c, lanes 1–4).

annotations.proposed_function: Forms intranuclear aggregates when expressed
annotations.evidence: When COS-7 cells were transfected with pT-DRPLAQ57-NLS-GFP, a strong GFP fluorescence was observed only in the nuclei, and several large intranuclear aggregates were formed (Fig. 2t).

annotations.proposed_function: Co-localizes with TAFII130 in intranuclear aggregates
annotations.evidence: Such co-localization was also observed in COS-7 cells co-expressing truncated mutant huntingtin (pT-HDQ82-NLS-GFP; Fig. 2p–r).

annotations.proposed_function: Cause a progressive neurological phenotype in transgenic mice
annotations.evidence: Mangiarini, L. et al. Exon 1 of the HD gene with an expanded CAG repeat is sufficient to cause a progressive neurological phenotype in transgenic mice.

annotations.proposed_function: Alters nuclear matrix-associated structures
annotations.evidence: Skinner, P.J. et al. Ataxin-1 with an expanded glutamine tract alters nuclear matrix-associated structures.

annotations.proposed_function: Aggregates in neuronal intranuclear inclusions and dystrophic neurites
annotations.evidence: DiFiglia, M. et al. Aggregation of huntingtin in neuronal intranuclear inclusions and dystrophic neurites in brain.

annotations.proposed_function: Forms intranuclear inclusions of expanded polyglutamine protein
annotations.evidence: Paulson, H.L. et al. Intranuclear inclusions of expanded polyglutamine protein in spinocerebellar ataxia type 3.

annotations.proposed_function: Suppression of aggregate formation and apoptosis by transglutaminase inhibitors
annotations.evidence: Igarashi, S. et al. Suppression of aggregate formation and apoptosis by transglutaminase inhibitors in cells expressing truncated DRPLA protein with an expanded polyglutamine stretch.

annotations.proposed_function: Forms nuclear inclusions in spinal and bulbar muscular atrophy
annotations.evidence: Li, M. et al. Nuclear inclusions of the androgen receptor protein in spinal and bulbar muscular atrophy.

annotations.proposed_function: Preferential intranuclear aggregate formation and apoptosis
annotations.evidence: Sato, A. et al. Adenovirus-mediated expression of mutant DRPLA proteins with expanded polyglutamine stretches in neuronally differentiated PC12 cells. Preferential intranuclear aggregate formation and apoptosis.

annotations.proposed_function: Cleavage by apopain is modulated by the polyglutamine tract
annotations.evidence: Goldberg, Y.P. et al. Cleavage of huntingtin by apopain, a proapoptotic cysteine protease, is modulated by the polyglutamine tract.

annotations.proposed_function: Nuclear localization and aggregation role in polyglutamine‑induced disease
annotations.evidence: Klement, I.A. et al. Ataxin-1 nuclear localization and aggregation: role in polyglutamine-induced disease in SCA1 transgenic mice.

annotations.proposed_function: Low‑complexity polyglutamine repeat promotes oligomerization and aggregation of the protein.
annotations.evidence: Oligomerization of expanded-polyglutamine domain fluorescent fusion proteins in cultured mammalian cells.

annotations.proposed_function: Binds polyglutamine tracts (low‑complexity regions) and inhibits transcription activation.
annotations.evidence: PQBP-1, a novel polyglutamine tract-binding protein, inhibits transcription activation by Brn-2 and affects cell survival.

annotations.proposed_function: required for stable RNA binding and enhances RNA-binding affinity
annotations.evidence: Here, we show that a low-complexity region proximal to the Mmi1 YTH domain is required for stable RNA binding.

annotations.proposed_function: enhances RNA binding and stabilizes interaction with DSR RNA
annotations.evidence: Mmi1 low-complexity region enhances RNA binding

annotations.proposed_function: enhances RNA binding
annotations.evidence: Mmi1 low-complexity region enhances RNA binding

annotations.proposed_function: stabilizes the protein conformation and reduces flexibility of the N‑clamp upon RNA binding
annotations.evidence: These data are consistent with the USR contributing to the interaction with RNA via stabilizing the conformation and reducing the flexibility of the N-clamp in solution.

annotations.proposed_function: Stabilizes a conformation of the YTH domain that binds RNA with high affinity, acting as an enhancer element to fine‑tune protein conformation and increase RNA binding affinity.
annotations.evidence: In the case of Mmi1, the USR stabilizes a conformation of the YTH domain that binds RNA with high affinity.
